reason: After reviewing the entire 10-K filing excerpt provided for Cohu, Inc. (fiscal year ended December 27, 2025), no total addressable market (TAM) figures were disclosed by the company itself. The filing contains extensive information about the company's business, products, strategy, and market presence (serving over 280 facilities across 108 customers in 31 countries with 25,000+ systems installed base), but does not provide specific TAM dollar figures or market size estimates disclosed by Cohu in its regulatory filings, investor presentations, or earnings materials. The company describes its markets and growth opportunities (HBM inspection, AI processor test, SiC/GaN testing, etc.) but does not quantify the addressable market size for these segments.
